Subject: Staff grievances regarding MACP /NFU/NFSG through HR-Soft - reg.

Madam/Sir,

This has reference to circular letter no. A-45011/137/2022-HRM-VIII/10357 dated 12-09-
2022 vide which user manual on staff grievance was circulated. Further two more type of categories
i.e. NFU and NFSG have been added.

2. It is requested to widely circulate the same to all officers and staff and issue of concern
regarding MACP/NFU/NEFSG be invited from the staff before 10.10.2022 through HR-Soft. All such
grievances so received up to 10.10.2022 be redressed by 30.10.2022 and action take report be sent to
HO by 3.11.2022.

Yours faithfully,

uw.

(Uma Mandal)
: Addl, Central P.F, Commissioner (HRM)
